label: Paid sick leave each year
context: For eligible employees, including part-time and casual employees, to care for themselves, their partners and children, or other dependants. The entitlement is not pro-rated.

label: Time worked before sick and bereavement leave starts
context: An employee qualifies after working for the employer continuously for this long, or after this long at an average of 10 hours a week with at least 1 hour in every week or 40 hours in every month.

label: Most sick leave an employee can accumulate
context: Unused sick leave at the end of a 12-month period is added to the next year's entitlement up to this total. An employer and employee can agree on a higher limit.

label: Bereavement leave for a close family member or a miscarriage or stillbirth
context: The minimum for each bereavement when an immediate family member dies, or when the employee or their partner has a miscarriage or stillbirth.

label: Bereavement leave when someone else dies
context: The minimum for each bereavement where the employer accepts that the employee has had a bereavement, based on closeness, responsibility for the arrangements and any cultural responsibilities.
